page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m48.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated, compute-oriented instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.4 GHz. It provides 96 dedicated virtual CPUs coupled with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPU equipped with 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance includes a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps to support intensive data transfers between distributed services. It contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system installations.

Without included local NVMe drives or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, storage throughput and networking ingress rely directly on complementary cloud infrastructure configurations. The combination of dense host computing capacity, substantial system memory, and a high-capacity workstation-class GPU makes the instance suitable for mid-scale AI model inference, graphics rendering pipelines, video encoding, and compute-heavy scientific simulation workloads.
